scripts.updateTelegramCommands:prod: vercel env pull .env.production.local --environment=production --yes && set -a && . ./.env.production.local && set +a && bun src/utils/commands.ts
scripts.build:api: rm -f api/*.mjs && bun build src/api/sync.ts src/api/summary.ts src/api/telegram.ts src/api/health.ts --outdir api --target node --format esm --external pg-native --entry-naming '[name].mjs'
